highlights: UGREEN FineTrack Slim Wallet Tracker Card (iOS Only) 45298

Ultra-Thin 0.07-Inch Credit Card Design: This FineTrack Slim wallet tracking card is designed to be the size of a credit card, with a thickness of only 0.07 inches (1.8 mm). It fits perfectly into any wallet card slot or passport holder, seamlessly integrating without adding any thickness.
It is the perfect travel companion or everyday carry item.
Easy Find with Apple Find My(iOS Only):Open the pre-installed Find My App and pair your wallet tracking card with your iPhone or iPad with a single tap.
Easily locate and track your wallet, luggage, and other valuables. (Note: Compatible with iOS devices only, not for Android.)
Magnetic Charging & Long Battery Life: Unlike ordinary trackers , this smart wallet tracking card comes with a dedicated charging cable, eliminating the need for a separate purchase.
